newsitem.title: USA: Greg Manning Auctions can't finalize deal.
newsitem.headline: Greg Manning Auctions can't finalize deal.

text.p: Greg Manning Auctions Inc said Monday it was unable to reach a final agreement to acquire Latham Cos Inc.
Latham Cos is a private company in Scottsdale, Ariz., that owns Larry Latham Auctioneers, a major real estate auctioneer.
Under the initial agreement, announced in mid-October, it was to have acquired Latham for 1,661,874 shares of Greg Manning stock.
"We regret the parties were not able to agree on acceptable terms for the proposed transaction," company Chairman and Chief Executive Greg Manning said in a statement.
"However, we will continue to pursue and evaluate other appropriate acquisition opportunities as part of our long-term plans for growth."
Greg Manning specializes in auctioning collectibles, such as stamps and sports cards.
